title: Burden Adduɗo Sellinde
intro: Ruuhu jarribaama haa ɓurti, ittaama weltaare, sehilaaɓe, e semmbe ɓanndu. Isolated e nder caɗeele luggiɗe, oo maccuɗo Alla ruttitii tan ko e Alla. E nder muñal e duwaawu ɓernde, ɓuuɓol yurmeende arii, ɓurngol ko miijinoo fof. Hol ooɗoo limre nde dewal mum udditi damal restoraasiyoŋ ?
clues: Miin ko mi maccuɗo Alla jiɗɗo, weltiiɗo e keewal, galle ɓuuɓɗo, cellal moƴƴal e balɗe am.
Ndeen jarribo jippiima : jawdi yalti, yiɗɓe njalti, ɓanndu am e hoore am yani e caɗeele mawɗe.
Ɓeen ɓadtiiɓe mi mbaawaano muñde ngonka am, mi heddii miɗo woɗɗitoo, ɓanndu am ina ɓuuɓtoo e caɗeele.
Mi noddii Joomiraacfo am, mi anndini wonde Seycfaane memi mi e 6uu6ol e jukkungo.
Jaabawol ngol ari — yamiroore fiyde leydi e koyngal am, e maggal ndiyam coofɗam yaltata ngam sellinde.
Joom am itti caɗeele ɗee fof, artiri mi ɓesngu am, ɓeydii, ko maande yurmeende wonande miijotooɓe.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
